decisions.reason: PFK expands to phosphofructokinase in the canonical. Independently retrieved original enzyme-assay research explicitly measures PFK activity. A fictional comparison of two sample activities is concrete and natural; lower/second/first are faithfully retained in Chinese, without a claim about a published result.

The professional anatomy associations independently confirm the historical JNA naming system and competing terminology standards. Atlases adopting different standards can use different names; the fictional causal comparison is coherent. The name is already canonical and abbreviation precision does not introduce another grammatical sense.

The original 1976 methods paper explicitly defines fluorescence photobleaching recovery/FPR and measurement of lateral mobility of fluorescently labelled molecules on cell surfaces. The new membrane-mobility sentence accurately demonstrates that method, with faithful Chinese and no unsupported experimental parameters.

The two original experimental papers independently use LcH/LCH for Lens culinaris hemagglutinin and describe cell-surface glycoprotein binding. The new sentence depicts a possible observed binding event, not a universal claim about every glycoprotein. Chinese preserves the agent and target roles.

CDC independently expands SUD as sudden unexpected death, resolving the omitted death in the source English without changing its explicit Chinese referent. Comparing circumstances of cases in two regions is a natural research use; no cause, rate or real regional finding is invented.

The BOOM developers describe functional-unit scheduling readiness and a non-pipelined divider that cannot accept work while busy. The sentence is one instruction waiting for such a unit, not a claim that all FUs are non-pipelined. The stored functional-component meaning is selected and Chinese matches the dependency.

The original clinical measurement paper explicitly uses blood cholinesterase/ChE activity. Both sample count and laboratory action match in Chinese. The mixed-case ChE is an attested abbreviation of the selected canonical enzyme, not an unreviewed replacement sense or a fabricated derived form.

The complete canonical explicitly identifies Toynbee as a surname. A fictional unnamed person waiting while a librarian fetches a book is natural and accurately translated; it does not invent a biography or claim the action of a particular historical Toynbee.

NERC/BODC independently identifies NOO as the historical US Navy Oceanographic Office, and a US Navy institutional document confirms its bathymetric/oceanographic data-provision role. Comparing depth measurements to its data is concrete and the Chinese preserves data provenance, without confusing NOO with NOAA.

FDA original medical-review text explicitly expands HMG as human menopausal gonadotropin and places it in fertility treatment. A doctor discussing it as part of that treatment is a plausible fictional consultation. Chinese is equivalent; the sentence gives no regimen, dosage or advice.

The original English correctly uses the technical collocation illocutionary force of a request. Stanford explains force as a speech-act dimension, and Cambridge explicitly gives the source wording 语内表现行为的 for this adjective, confirming it is not a different locutionary sense. The new Chinese 施事效力 fixes the physical-force mistranslation.

Original electrophoresis research independently attests ZE for zone electrophoresis, and a protein-purification study measures protein mobility and migration velocity in this method. Two proteins migrating at different speeds is a possible concrete observation, not a universal result. The Chinese matches both process and comparison.

method: Independent second reader manually read every one of the 12 newly authored five-field EN/ZH rows, old rows and complete authenticated canonical records/all variants and samefold case neighbours. Fresh primary lexical, institutional, technical and research sources were checked. New sentences were also checked against the complete current 103,998-pair corpus, active everyday/selected sources and all 17 compiled corrections for normalized exact duplication; existing effective alternatives were not recounted.
evidenceLimits: The direct PMC pages for the author-provided PFK and ZE references presented a recaptcha during this independent check; those inaccessible direct responses were not treated as read. Alternate readable original PubMed research was used and cited in the decisions.
The FDA scanned PDF returned no direct extracted text; its indexed original FDA text independently gave the HMG expansion and fertility-treatment context.
All examples are assessed as fictional learning examples, not assertions that their narrated observations or events occurred in a specific real study.
scope: Only the 12 exact new row digests and recorded source/canonical hashes. This review does not approve the original low-information examples or declare other old dictionary senses accurate.
